fields.note: Office names from the page's Greenhouse rows (offices/location); many postings list several cities

notes: The see-jobs page is a server-rendered GreenhouseV2 component: its inline window.__serverData embeds every row (meta.total 377 at review) plus the department tree, and declares the feed api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/mongodb/jobs?content=true. facetedFilters.isFaceted=true with filterLabel "Search": keyword box, Department checkbox list, Location checkbox list, "Clear all". All filtering and the 10-per-page pagination are client-side React state - the Greenhouse v1 feed and the page take no filter query parameters.
